subject: alt-d
title: (R)ALT.D.------TH.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 66 (SD(SY)-44). ALT-D (alternative definitions) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is the partner. From TH-CONT: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From INFO-DE-B: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics), DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", AFI (affinity insight) and AFL (affinity alignment). S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of", is on a dotted line from SOC-RT-DY. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is on a dotted line from DEF. From AFI: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From ALT-C-PG: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of".
